verdict.rationale: Pipedream exposes machine-readable equivalents like llms.txt indexes, per-app .md docs, and MCP's own tool-schema discovery (mcpClient.tools() dynamically loads tool definitions), but there is no explicit OpenAPI/Swagger spec file offered for download. Missing for 10: an actual OpenAPI/JSON-schema spec document, explicit 'download spec' feature, and independent confirmation of spec completeness.
